title: Pricing page gets motion graphics for the plans, Collective or Network, and sales fees; plan buttons open sign up then Create a Space

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21: work the pricing infographics into the page, connect them to the system, point every link at the right place.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. Three CSS-only motion figures (plan ladder, Collective or Network, what you pay on sales) replace the static tier graphics on /pricing. Prices read the Offering model and NETWORK_PLAN (Network $149 plus $59 a chapter, three included; Independent from $30,000 plus $5,000 setup), colors are kit tokens, every animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion. Every Space plan button and the page hero and close now go to OPERATOR_START_HREF (/join?next=/spaces/new) instead of the /spaces explainer. The Network and Independent mailto links moved to lib/pricing/network-contact.ts so both pages share them.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/site/pages/pricing/plan-motion.tsx','utf8');const g=fs.readFileSync('lib/pricing/pricing-grid.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(/#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\b/.test(m))bad.push('hex in motion graphics');if(/href: '\/spaces'/.test(g))bad.push('plan button points at /spaces');if(!/prefers-reduced-motion/.test(fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/site-pages-b.css','utf8')))bad.push('no reduced motion');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1197: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails on a hard-coded hex in the figures, a plan button pointing back at /spaces, or a sheet with no reduced-motion rule.
